We are looking for a Business Analyst with strong experience in Consumer Banking Applications to drive requirement gathering, process improvement, and solution delivery across banking technology initiatives.

📍 Location: Mumbai (Onsite)

💼 Experience: 5 + Years

Key Responsibilities

• Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements. 
• Create User Stories, BRDs, FRDs, use cases, process flows, and functional specifications. 
• Facilitate business process re-engineering and process improvement initiatives. 
• Work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology teams to deliver solutions. 
• Ensure requirements are clearly communicated and translated into technical specifications. 
• Manage stakeholder expectations and provide regular project updates. 
• Support UAT, issue resolution, and project implementation activities. 

Required Skills

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst. 
• Mandatory experience in Consumer Banking Applications . 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. 
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. 
• Experience in requirement gathering, process mapping, and business analysis. 
• Ability to work in Agile environments and collaborate with cross-functional teams. 
• Strong attention to detail and continuous improvement mindset. 

Preferred

• Experience in Banking, FinTech, or Digital Banking projects. 
• Exposure to digital channels, lending, payments, deposits, or retail banking products. 

👉 If you are passionate about transforming banking experiences through technology and business analysis, we'd love to hear from you.
